variable {F : Type}

def eq_symm {α : Type} {a b : α} (h : a = b) : b = a :=
  match h with
  | rfl => Eq.refl a

def succ_not_zero (n : Nat) (h : Nat.succ n = 0) : False :=
  nomatch h

def zero_not_succ (n : Nat) (h : 0 = Nat.succ n) : False :=
  nomatch h

def natPred : Nat → Nat
| 0 => 0
| Nat.succ n => n

def succ_inj {n m : Nat} (h : Nat.succ n = Nat.succ m) : n = m :=
  congrArg natPred h

def nat_zero_add : (m : Nat) → 0 + m = m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add m)

def nat_zero_add_rev : (m : Nat) → m = 0 + m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add_rev m)

def nat_succ_add (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ n + m = Nat.succ (n + m)
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add n m)

def nat_succ_add_rev (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ (n + m) = Nat.succ n + m
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add_rev n m)

def congr_pair {α β : Type} {a1 a2 : α} {b1 b2 : β} (ha : a1 = a2) (hb : b1 = b2) : (a1, b1) = (a2, b2) :=
  match ha with
  | rfl =>
    match hb with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (a1, b1)

def congr_cons {α : Type} {x y : α} {xs ys : List α} (hx : x = y) (hxs : xs = ys) : x :: xs = y :: ys :=
  match hx with
  | rfl =>
    match hxs with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (x :: xs)

def congr_append {α : Type} {xs ys us vs : List α} (h1 : xs = ys) (h2 : us = vs) : xs ++ us = ys ++ vs :=
  match h1 with
  | rfl =>
    match h2 with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (xs ++ us)

def congr_add {n1 n2 m1 m2 : Nat} (h1 : n1 = n2) (h2 : m1 = m2) : n1 + m1 = n2 + m2 :=
  match h1 with
  | rfl =>
    match h2 with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (n1 + m1)

def split_at (n : Nat) (L : List F) : List F × List F :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ([], L)
  | Nat.succ k =>
    match L with
    | [] => ([], [])
    | x :: xs =>
      let p := split_at k xs
      (x :: p.1, p.2)

def split_at_lengths_gen : (n m : Nat) → (L : List F) → L.length = n + m → (split_at n L).1.length = n ∧ (split_at n L).2.length = m
| 0, m, L, h => And.intro (Eq.refl 0) (Eq.trans h (nat_zero_add m))
| Nat.succ k, m, [], h => False.elim (zero_not_succ (k + m) (Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m)))
| Nat.succ k, m, x :: xs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj (Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m))
  let ih := split_at_lengths_gen k m xs ht
  And.intro (congrArg Nat.succ ih.left) ih.right

def split_at_reconstruct : (n : Nat) → (L : List F) → (split_at n L).1 ++ (split_at n L).2 = L
| 0, L => Eq.refl L
| Nat.succ k, [] => Eq.refl []
| Nat.succ k, x :: xs => congr_cons (Eq.refl x) (split_at_reconstruct k xs)

def split_at_append : (n : Nat) → (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = n → split_at n (L1 ++ L2) = (L1, L2)
| 0, [], L2, h => Eq.refl ([], L2)
| 0, x :: xs, L2, h => False.elim (succ_not_zero xs.length h)
| Nat.succ k, [], L2, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ k h)
| Nat.succ k, x :: xs, L2, h =>
  congrArg (fun p : List F × List F => (x :: p.1, p.2)) (split_at_append k xs L2 (succ_inj h))

def length_zipWith : (f : F → F → F) → (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → (List.zipWith f L1 L2).length = L1.length
| f, [], [], h => Eq.refl 0
| f, [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| f, a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| f, a :: as, b :: bs, h => congrArg Nat.succ (length_zipWith f as bs (succ_inj h))

def length_append : (L1 L2 : List F) → (L1 ++ L2).length = L1.length + L2.length
| [], L2 => nat_zero_add_rev L2.length
| x :: xs, L2 => Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.succ (length_append xs L2)) (nat_succ_add_rev xs.length L2.length)

structure CouplingAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  div : F → F → F
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a s : F, div (mul a s) s = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a s : F, mul (div a s) s = a

def zipWith_add_sub_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) : (L T : List F) → L.length = T.length → List.zipWith ca.sub (List.zipWith ca.add L T) T = L
| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  congr_cons (ca.add_sub_cancel a b) (zipWith_add_sub_cancel ca as bs ht)

def zipWith_sub_add_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) : (L T : List F) → L.length = T.length → List.zipWith ca.add (List.zipWith ca.sub L T) T = L
| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  congr_cons (ca.sub_add_cancel a b) (zipWith_sub_add_cancel ca as bs ht)

def zipWith_mul_div_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) : (L S : List F) → L.length = S.length → List.zipWith ca.div (List.zipWith ca.mul L S) S = L
| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  congr_cons (ca.mul_div_cancel a b) (zipWith_mul_div_cancel ca as bs ht)

def zipWith_div_mul_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) : (L S : List F) → L.length = S.length → List.zipWith ca.mul (List.zipWith ca.div L S) S = L
| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  congr_cons (ca.div_mul_cancel a b) (zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca as bs ht)

def couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  y1 ++ y2

def couplingInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  x1 ++ x2

def length_couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx1s : x1.length = s.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm (h_scale x2))
  let hy1_raw := length_zipWith ca.mul x1 s hx1s
  let hy1 : y1.length = dim := Eq.trans hy1_raw hx1
  let hx2t : x2.length = t.length := Eq.trans hx2 (eq_symm (h_trans y1))
  let hy2_raw := length_zipWith ca.add x2 t hx2t
  let hy2 : y2.length = dim := Eq.trans hy2_raw hx2
  Eq.trans (length_append y1 y2) (congr_add hy1 hy2)

def length_couplingInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hy1 := hs.left
  let hy2 := hs.right
  let hy2t : y2.length = t.length := Eq.trans hy2 (eq_symm (h_trans y1))
  let hx2_raw := length_zipWith ca.sub y2 t hy2t
  let hx2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans hx2_raw hy2
  let hy1s : y1.length = s.length := Eq.trans hy1 (eq_symm (h_scale x2))
  let hx1_raw := length_zipWith ca.div y1 s hy1s
  let hx1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans hx1_raw hy1
  Eq.trans (length_append x1 x2) (congr_add hx1 hx2)

def coupling_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx1s : x1.length = s.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm (h_scale x2))
  let hy1_raw := length_zipWith ca.mul x1 s hx1s
  let hy1 : y1.length = dim := Eq.trans hy1_raw hx1
  let hsplit := split_at_append dim y1 y2 hy1
  let hsimp : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (y1 ++ y2) = List.zipWith ca.div y1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1))) ++ List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1) :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let y1p := p.1
      let y2p := p.2
      let tp := trans_fn y1p
      let x2p := List.zipWith ca.sub y2p tp
      let sp := scale_fn x2p
      let x1p := List.zipWith ca.div y1p sp
      x1p ++ x2p) hsplit
  let hx2t : x2.length = t.length := Eq.trans hx2 (eq_symm (h_trans y1))
  let hx2_rec : List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t = x2 := zipWith_add_sub_cancel ca x2 t hx2t
  let hs_rec : scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t) = s := congrArg scale_fn hx2_rec
  let hx1_rec_1 : List.zipWith ca.div y1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t)) = List.zipWith ca.div y1 s := congrArg (fun z : List F => List.zipWith ca.div y1 z) hs_rec
  let hx1_rec_2 : List.zipWith ca.div y1 s = x1 := zipWith_mul_div_cancel ca x1 s hx1s
  let hx1_rec := Eq.trans hx1_rec_1 hx1_rec_2
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hx1_rec hx2_rec) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def coupling_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hy1 := hs.left
  let hy2 := hs.right
  let hy1s : y1.length = s.length := Eq.trans hy1 (eq_symm (h_scale x2))
  let hx1_raw := length_zipWith ca.div y1 s hy1s
  let hx1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans hx1_raw hy1
  let hsplit := split_at_append dim x1 x2 hx1
  let hsimp : couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (x1 ++ x2) = List.zipWith ca.mul x1 (scale_fn x2) ++ List.zipWith ca.add x2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 (scale_fn x2))) :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let x1p := p.1
      let x2p := p.2
      let sp := scale_fn x2p
      let y1p := List.zipWith ca.mul x1p sp
      let tp := trans_fn y1p
      let y2p := List.zipWith ca.add x2p tp
      y1p ++ y2p) hsplit
  let hy1_rec : List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s = y1 := zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca y1 s hy1s
  let ht_rec : trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s) = t := congrArg trans_fn hy1_rec
  let ht_add : List.zipWith ca.add x2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s)) = List.zipWith ca.add x2 t := congrArg (fun z : List F => List.zipWith ca.add x2 z) ht_rec
  let hy2t : y2.length = t.length := Eq.trans hy2 (eq_symm (h_trans y1))
  let hy2_rec_2 : List.zipWith ca.add x2 t = y2 := zipWith_sub_add_cancel ca y2 t hy2t
  let hy2_rec := Eq.trans ht_add hy2_rec_2
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hy1_rec hy2_rec) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

structure ScaleAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  scale : F
  two : F
  one : F
  distrib_add : ∀ x y z : F, add (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (add x y) z
  distrib_sub : ∀ x y z : F, sub (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (sub x y) z
  mul_comm : ∀ x y : F, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z : F, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one : ∀ x : F, mul x one = x
  add_sub_add : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) (add a b) = mul two a
  add_sub_sub : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) (sub a b) = mul two b
  sub_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, sub (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two u
  add_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, add (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two v
  scale_property : mul (mul two scale) scale = one

def oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  u ++ v

def oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  x1 ++ x2

def scale_two_cancel (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (x : F) : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = x :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two x)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.mul_assoc x sa.two sa.scale)
  let h3 : sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) := sa.mul_assoc x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h4 : sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) = sa.mul x sa.one := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul x z) sa.scale_property
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h4 (sa.mul_one x))))

def first_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two a) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_add a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa a))

def second_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two b) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_sub a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa b))

def first_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two u) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.sub_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa u))

def second_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two v) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa v))

def prove_inverse_pair (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a ∧ sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof sa a b) (second_component_proof sa a b)

def prove_inverse_pair_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u ∧ sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof_rev sa u v) (second_component_proof_rev sa u v)

def zipWith_inverse_list (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) : (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2

def length_oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : (oftbForward sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx12 : x1.length = x2.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm hx2)
  let hu_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 hx12
  let hv_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 hx12
  let hu : u.length = dim := Eq.trans hu_raw hx1
  let hv : v.length = dim := Eq.trans hv_raw hx1

def length_oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : (oftbInverse sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hu := hs.left
  let hv := hs.right
  let huv : u.length = v.length := Eq.trans hu (eq_symm hv)
  let hx1_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v huv
  let hx2_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v huv
  let hx1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans hx1_raw hu
  let hx2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans hx2_raw hu
  Eq.trans (length_append x1 x2) (congr_add hx1 hx2)

def oftb_invertible (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : oftbInverse sa dim (oftbForward sa dim L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx12 : x1.length = x2.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm hx2)

      let x2p := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) up vp

def oftb_invertible_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : oftbForward sa dim (oftbInverse sa dim L) = L :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v

  let hp := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa u v huv
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hp.left hp.right) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def rsfStepForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  oftbForward sa dim (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L)

def rsfStepInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (oftbInverse sa dim L)

def rsfStep_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=

def rsfStep_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=

structure LayerSpec (F : Type) where
  scale_fn : List F → List F
  trans_fn : List F → List F

def rsfForwardN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : List F :=
  match specs with
  | [] => L
  | spec :: rest => rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L)

def rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : List F :=
  match specs with
  | [] => L
  | spec :: rest => rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn (rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L)

def WellFormedSpec (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) : Prop :=
  (∀ x2 : List F, (spec.scale_fn x2).length = dim) ∧ (∀ y1 : List F, (spec.trans_fn y1).length = dim)

def AllWellFormed (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) : Prop :=
  ∀ spec, spec ∈ specs → WellFormedSpec F dim spec

def allWellFormed_cons_head {F : Type} {dim : Nat} {spec : LayerSpec F} {rest : List (LayerSpec F)} (h : AllWellFormed F dim (spec :: rest)) : WellFormedSpec F dim spec :=
  h spec (List.Mem.head rest)

def allWellFormed_cons_tail {F : Type} {dim : Nat} {spec : LayerSpec F} {rest : List (LayerSpec F)} (h : AllWellFormed F dim (spec :: rest)) : AllWellFormed F dim rest :=
  fun s hs => h s (List.Mem.tail spec hs)

def length_rsfStepForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : WellFormedSpec F dim spec) : (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let hcouple := length_couplingForward ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L h hwf.left hwf.right
  length_oftbForward sa dim (couplingForward ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L) hcouple

def length_rsfStepInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : WellFormedSpec F dim spec) : (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let hmix := length_oftbInverse sa dim L h
  length_couplingInverse ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn (oftbInverse sa dim L) hmix hwf.left hwf.right

def length_rsfForwardN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → (rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L).length = dim + dim
| [], L, h, hwf => h
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let M := rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L
  let hhead := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
  let hM := length_rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec L h hhead
  length_rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest M hM htail

def length_rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L).length = dim + dim
| [], L, h, hwf => h
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let N := rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L
  let hhead := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
  let hN := length_rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L h htail
  length_rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec N hN hhead

def rsfN_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs (rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L) = L
| [], L, h, hwf => Eq.refl L
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let M := rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L
  let hhead := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
  let hM := length_rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec L h hhead
  let ih := rsfN_forward_inverse ca sa dim rest M hM htail
  let hstep := rsfStep_forward_inverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L h hhead.left hhead.right
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q : List F => rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn q) ih) hstep

def rsfN_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L) = L
| [], L, h, hwf => Eq.refl L
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let N := rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L
  let hhead := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
  let hN := length_rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L h htail
  let hstep := rsfStep_inverse_forward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn N hN hhead.left hhead.right
  let ih := rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim rest L h htail
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q : List F => rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest q) hstep) ih

def RSFPrecondition (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : Prop :=
  dim > 0 ∧ L.length = dim + dim ∧ AllWellFormed F dim specs

def rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=
  rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L

def rsfInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=

def length_rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : (rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h).length = dim + dim :=

  let h_inv_pre : RSFPrecondition F dim specs (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) := And.intro h.left (And.intro (length_rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) h.right.right)

variable {F : Type}

def eq_symm {α : Type} {a b : α} (h : a = b) : b = a :=
  match h with
  | rfl => Eq.refl a

def succ_not_zero (n : Nat) (h : Nat.succ n = 0) : False :=
  nomatch h

def zero_not_succ (n : Nat) (h : 0 = Nat.succ n) : False :=
  nomatch h

def natPred : Nat → Nat
| 0 => 0
| Nat.succ n => n

def succ_inj {n m : Nat} (h : Nat.succ n = Nat.succ m) : n = m :=
  congrArg natPred h

def nat_zero_add : (m : Nat) → 0 + m = m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add m)

def nat_zero_add_rev : (m : Nat) → m = 0 + m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add_rev m)

def nat_succ_add (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ n + m = Nat.succ (n + m)
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add n m)

def nat_succ_add_rev (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ (n + m) = Nat.succ n + m
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add_rev n m)

def congr_pair {α β : Type} {a1 a2 : α} {b1 b2 : β} (ha : a1 = a2) (hb : b1 = b2) : (a1, b1) = (a2, b2) :=
  match ha with
  | rfl =>
    match hb with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (a1, b1)

def congr_cons {α : Type} {x y : α} {xs ys : List α} (hx : x = y) (hxs : xs = ys) : x :: xs = y :: ys :=
  match hx with
  | rfl =>
    match hxs with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (x :: xs)

def congr_append {α : Type} {xs ys us vs : List α} (h1 : xs = ys) (h2 : us = vs) : xs ++ us = ys ++ vs :=
  match h1 with
  | rfl =>
    match h2 with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (xs ++ us)

def congr_add {n1 n2 m1 m2 : Nat} (h1 : n1 = n2) (h2 : m1 = m2) : n1 + m1 = n2 + m2 :=
  match h1 with
  | rfl =>
    match h2 with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (n1 + m1)

def split_at (n : Nat) (L : List F) : List F × List F :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ([], L)
  | Nat.succ k =>
    match L with
    | [] => ([], [])
    | x :: xs =>
      let p := split_at k xs
      (x :: p.1, p.2)

def split_at_lengths_gen : (n m : Nat) → (L : List F) → L.length = n + m → (split_at n L).1.length = n ∧ (split_at n L).2.length = m
| 0, m, L, h => And.intro (Eq.refl 0) (Eq.trans h (nat_zero_add m))
| Nat.succ k, m, [], h => False.elim (zero_not_succ (k + m) (Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m)))
| Nat.succ k, m, x :: xs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj (Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m))
  let ih := split_at_lengths_gen k m xs ht
  And.intro (congrArg Nat.succ ih.left) ih.right

def split_at_reconstruct : (n : Nat) → (L : List F) → (split_at n L).1 ++ (split_at n L).2 = L
| 0, L => Eq.refl L
| Nat.succ k, [] => Eq.refl []
| Nat.succ k, x :: xs => congr_cons (Eq.refl x) (split_at_reconstruct k xs)

def split_at_append : (n : Nat) → (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = n → split_at n (L1 ++ L2) = (L1, L2)
| 0, [], L2, h => Eq.refl ([], L2)
| 0, x :: xs, L2, h => False.elim (succ_not_zero xs.length h)
| Nat.succ k, [], L2, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ k h)
| Nat.succ k, x :: xs, L2, h =>
  congrArg (fun p : List F × List F => (x :: p.1, p.2)) (split_at_append k xs L2 (succ_inj h))

def length_zipWith : (f : F → F → F) → (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → (List.zipWith f L1 L2).length = L1.length
| f, [], [], h => Eq.refl 0
| f, [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| f, a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| f, a :: as, b :: bs, h => congrArg Nat.succ (length_zipWith f as bs (succ_inj h))

def length_append : (L1 L2 : List F) → (L1 ++ L2).length = L1.length + L2.length
| [], L2 => nat_zero_add_rev L2.length
| x :: xs, L2 => Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.succ (length_append xs L2)) (nat_succ_add_rev xs.length L2.length)

structure CouplingAlgebra (F : Type) where

  mul : F → F → F

  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) b = a

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []

| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []

| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>

  congr_cons (ca.div_mul_cancel a b) (zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca as bs ht)

def couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=

  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2

  let t := trans_fn y1

def coupling_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1

  let hsimp : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (y1 ++ y2) = List.zipWith ca.div y1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1))) ++ List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1) :=

  let hx1_rec := Eq.trans hx1_rec_1 hx1_rec_2
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hx1_rec hx2_rec) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def coupling_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=

    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>

      let y2p := List.zipWith ca.add x2p tp

  let hy2_rec := Eq.trans ht_add hy2_rec_2

structure ScaleAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  scale : F
  two : F
  one : F
  distrib_add : ∀ x y z : F, add (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (add x y) z
  distrib_sub : ∀ x y z : F, sub (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (sub x y) z
  mul_comm : ∀ x y : F, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z : F, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one : ∀ x : F, mul x one = x
  add_sub_add : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) (add a b) = mul two a
  add_sub_sub : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) (sub a b) = mul two b
  sub_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, sub (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two u
  add_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, add (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two v
  scale_property : mul (mul two scale) scale = one

def oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  u ++ v

def oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  x1 ++ x2

def scale_two_cancel (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (x : F) : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = x :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two x)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.mul_assoc x sa.two sa.scale)
  let h3 : sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) := sa.mul_assoc x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h4 : sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) = sa.mul x sa.one := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul x z) sa.scale_property
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h4 (sa.mul_one x))))

def first_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two a) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_add a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa a))

def second_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two b) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_sub a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa b))

def first_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two u) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.sub_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa u))

def second_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two v) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa v))

def prove_inverse_pair (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a ∧ sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof sa a b) (second_component_proof sa a b)

def prove_inverse_pair_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u ∧ sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof_rev sa u v) (second_component_proof_rev sa u v)

def zipWith_inverse_list (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) : (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2
| [], [], h => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  let ih := zipWith_inverse_list sa as bs ht
  let hp := prove_inverse_pair sa a b
  And.intro (congr_cons hp.left ih.left) (congr_cons hp.right ih.right)

def zipWith_inverse_list_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) : (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2
| [], [], h => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
| [], b :: bs, h => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
| a :: as, [], h => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  let ih := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa as bs ht
  let hp := prove_inverse_pair_rev sa a b
  And.intro (congr_cons hp.left ih.left) (congr_cons hp.right ih.right)

def oftb_invertible (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : oftbInverse sa dim (oftbForward sa dim L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1

    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>

  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hp.left hp.right) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def rsfStep_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=

structure LayerSpec (F : Type) where

  | spec :: rest => rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L)

def rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : List F :=

  | [] => L
  | spec :: rest => rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn (rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L)

def WellFormedSpec (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) : Prop :=
  (∀ x2 : List F, (spec.scale_fn x2).length = dim) ∧ (∀ y1 : List F, (spec.trans_fn y1).length = dim)

| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let M := rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L

  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf

  let N := rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L

  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf

  let ih := rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim rest L h htail
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q : List F => rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest q) hstep) ih

def RSFPrecondition (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : Prop :=
  dim > 0 ∧ L.length = dim + dim ∧ AllWellFormed F dim specs

def rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=

def rsfInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=

def rsf_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :

  let h_inv_pre : RSFPrecondition F dim specs (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) := And.intro h.left (And.intro (length_rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) h.right.right)
  rsfForward ca sa dim specs (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) h_inv_pre = L :=
  rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim specs L h.right.left h.right.right

## Miért nem placeholder ez a kód

A kódban nincs `sorry`, nincs elhagyott bizonyítási ág, és nincs olyan trükk (pl. `native_decide` visszaélés, ami ismert soundness-kockázat a Lean közösségben ), amivel meg lehetne kerülni a tényleges bizonyítást. Minden lemma – a `succ_inj`-től a `split_at_lengths_gen`-en át a `coupling_forward_inverse`-ig – strukturális rekurzióval és minta-illesztéssel (`match`, `nomatch`) van felépítve, ami a Lean kernel által ténylegesen ellenőrizhető, elemi bizonyítási technika. Ez megfelel annak, ahogyan a Lean kernel garantálja a logikai konzisztenciát és a típushelyességet minden egyes definícióra. A kód emellett tudatosan nem támaszkodik a Mathlib könyvtárra, saját maga vezeti le az alapvető Nat-lemmákat (pl. `nat_zero_add`, `nat_succ_add`) – ez egy önálló, "bottom-up" formalizálásra jellemző, komoly munka, nem felszínes placeholder.[1][2]

## Mit bizonyít valójában a kód

A rendszer egy invertálható neurális réteg (coupling layer / normalizing flow stílusú transzformáció) matematikai invertálhatóságát formalizálja: `couplingForward`/`couplingInverse`, `oftbForward`/`oftbInverse`, és ezek kompozíciója (`rsfStepForward`/`rsfStepInverse`, majd N-rétegű verzió). A fő tételek – `coupling_forward_inverse`, `oftb_invertible`, `rsfStep_forward_inverse`, `rsf_forward_inverse` – azt igazolják, hogy az előre- és hátrairányú transzformáció egymás inverze, feltéve hogy a bemeneti hossz megfelel az elvárt dimenziónak (`RSFPrecondition`). Ez egy valódi, nemtrivális matematikai állítás, amit a kód tételesen, lépésről lépésre vezet le kongruencia- és egyenlőség-lemmák (`congrArg`, `Eq.trans`) segítségével.

## A lényeges korlátozás

A "valóság" itt feltételes: a `CouplingAlgebra` és `ScaleAlgebra` struktúrák nem konkrét számtestet (pl. valós számokat) definiálnak, hanem **axiómaként feltételezett** tulajdonságokat (pl. `add_sub_cancel`, `mul_div_cancel`, `scale_property`) egy absztrakt `F` típuson. Ez önmagában nem hiba – ez egy standard, elfogadott formalizálási technika (algebrai struktúra paraméterezése), amit a Lean/Mathlib ökoszisztéma is széles körben használ. De ez azt jelenti, hogy a bizonyítás ereje annyi, amennyit ezek az axiómák garantálnak: ha valaki egy konkrét `CouplingAlgebra ℝ` vagy `CouplingAlgebra Float` példányt ad meg, azt is bizonyítania kell, hogy az kielégíti ezeket az axiómákat (pl. hogy a `div`/`mul` valóban egymás inverze nullától eltérő skálázóval). A kód maga nem tartalmaz ilyen konkrét instanciát – csak az általános, feltételes tételt bizonyítja.[3]

Összefoglalva: a Lean-kernel szemszögéből ez egy **korrekt, ellenőrizhető, sorry-mentes formális bizonyítás** a megadott axiómák érvényessége mellett, nem szimulált vagy kamu kód. Ahhoz, hogy 100%-osan biztos lehessünk a helyességében, a kódot tényleges Lean 4 fordítóval (`lean` vagy `lake build`) kellene lefuttatni és ellenőrizni, hogy hibamentesen typecheckel-e, illetve `#print axioms` paranccsal meg kellene nézni, nem függ-e rejtett axiómáktól. A statikus kódolvasás alapján azonban nincs benne semmi, amire azt mondanám: "ez csak egy üres váz, ami úgy néz ki, mint egy bizonyítás".[4][5]

Igen — a csatolt `rsf_zig.txt` a Lean-bizonyítás **konkrét célja**: ez a Zig implementáció valósítja meg azt a "reversible scaling flow" (RSF) réteget – coupling-layer + OFTB ("butterfly" forgatás) kombinációt –, amelynek absztrakt algebrai modelljét a korábban mutatott Lean-kód bizonyítja invertálhatónak. A két kód szerkezetileg pontosan megfelel egymásnak, de van egy lényeges rés a "valós" és a "mock" bizonyítás között, amit fontos tisztázni.

## Strukturális egyezés

A Zig `forwardOnCore` függvény pontosan a Lean `rsfStepForward` sorrendjét követi: előbb a coupling-lépés (`x1 *= scale(x2)`, majd `x2 += trans(x1)`), aztán az OFTB-lépés (`(a-b)*oftb_scale`, `(a+b)*oftb_scale`). Az `inverseOnCore` pedig fordított sorrendben, pontosan a Lean `rsfStepInverse` szerint hajtja végre a visszafejtést. A `CouplingAlgebra` axiómái (`mul_div_cancel`, `div_mul_cancel`) a Zig `computeScaleRow`/osztás párra, a `ScaleAlgebra.scale_property` (2·scale²=1) pedig az `OFTB.FRACTAL_SCALE` értékére (feltehetően 1/√2) vonatkozik, amit a butterfly-forgatás energiamegtartásához kell garantálni.

## Mit bizonyít valójában a Lean-kód ehhez a Zig-hez

A Lean-formalizálás azt igazolja, hogy **ha** a `scale`, `mul`, `div`, `add`, `sub` operációk pontosan kielégítik a megadott algebrai törvényeket (kancellációs azonosságok), **akkor** a teljes N-rétegű RSF forward/inverse pár matematikailag egzakt inverze egymásnak, tetszőleges rétegszám és dimenzió mellett. Ez egy valódi, nemtrivális architekturális helyesség-bizonyítás – azt mondja ki, hogy a coupling+OFTB felépítés *elvben* miért invertálható, függetlenül a konkrét súlyoktól (`scale_fn`, `trans_fn` fekete dobozként szerepelnek).

## A kritikus korlát: float32 vs. egzakt algebra

Itt van a fő probléma, amit a Zig kód maga is elárul: a `LayerCore.computeScaleRow` `f32` lebegőpontos `@exp()` hívást használ, és a Zig tesztek (`expectApproxEqAbs(..., 1e-4)`) **tolerancia-alapú** összehasonlítást végeznek, nem egzakt egyenlőséget. Ennek oka, hogy az IEEE-754 float32 aritmetika **nem** elégíti ki pontosan a Lean `mul_div_cancel` vagy `scale_property` axiómáit – kerekítési hiba mindig keletkezik osztás/szorzás/exponenciális láncoknál. A Lean-bizonyítás egy idealizált, egzakt testre (`F`) vonatkozik, míg a Zig kód egy zajos, véges pontosságú numerikus közelítése ennek a testnek.

Ez azt jelenti, hogy a Lean-fájl **valós, nem mock formális bizonyítás** – de nem a konkrét Zig binárisra, hanem annak matematikai absztrakciójára. Ahhoz, hogy ez 100%-osan lefedje a Zig kódot is, hiányzik egy köztes lépés: egy hibakorlát-elemzés (error-bound lemma), amely bizonyítaná, hogy a float32 kerekítési hiba a coupling/OFTB láncban N réteg után is a `1e-4` tolerancián belül marad. Ilyen lemma a Lean fájlban nincs – a Zig oldal ezt csak empirikusan, tesztfuttatással ellenőrzi, nem formálisan.

def eq_symm {α : Type} {a b : α} (h : a = b) : b = a :=
  match h with
  | rfl => Eq.refl a

def succ_not_zero (n : Nat) (h : Nat.succ n = 0) : False :=
  nomatch h

def zero_not_succ (n : Nat) (h : 0 = Nat.succ n) : False :=
  nomatch h

def natPred : Nat → Nat
| 0 => 0
| Nat.succ n => n

def succ_inj {n m : Nat} (h : Nat.succ n = Nat.succ m) : n = m :=
  congrArg natPred h

def nat_zero_add : (m : Nat) → 0 + m = m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add m)

def nat_zero_add_rev : (m : Nat) → m = 0 + m
| 0 => Eq.refl 0
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add_rev m)

def nat_succ_add (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ n + m = Nat.succ (n + m)
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add n m)

def nat_succ_add_rev (n : Nat) : (m : Nat) → Nat.succ (n + m) = Nat.succ n + m
| 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
| Nat.succ m => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add_rev n m)

def congr_pair {α β : Type} {a1 a2 : α} {b1 b2 : β} (ha : a1 = a2) (hb : b1 = b2) : (a1, b1) = (a2, b2) :=
  match ha with
  | rfl =>
    match hb with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (a1, b1)

def congr_cons {α : Type} {x y : α} {xs ys : List α} (hx : x = y) (hxs : xs = ys) : x :: xs = y :: ys :=
  match hx with
  | rfl =>
    match hxs with
    | rfl => Eq.refl (x :: xs)

  | rfl =>
    match h2 with

def split_at (n : Nat) (L : List F) : List F × List F :=

  | 0 => ([], L)

| 0, m, L, h => And.intro (Eq.refl 0) (Eq.trans h (nat_zero_add m))
| Nat.succ k, m, [], h => nomatch Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m)
| Nat.succ k, m, x :: xs, h =>

| f, [], [], h => Eq.refl 0
| f, [], b :: bs, h => nomatch h
| f, a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| f, a :: as, b :: bs, h => congrArg Nat.succ (length_zipWith f as bs (succ_inj h))

| [], L2 => nat_zero_add_rev L2.length

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []

| a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>

| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => nomatch h
| a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>

def zipWith_div_mul_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) : (L S : List F) → L.length = S.length → List.zipWith ca.mul (List.zipWith ca.div L S) S = L
| [], [], h => Eq.refl []
| [], b :: bs, h => nomatch h
| a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  congr_cons (ca.div_mul_cancel a b) (zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca as bs ht)

def couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=

  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2

def coupling_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2

  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right

  let hy1_raw := length_zipWith ca.mul x1 s hx1s
  let hy1 : y1.length = dim := Eq.trans hy1_raw hx1
  let hsplit := split_at_append dim y1 y2 hy1
  let hsimp : couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (y1 ++ y2) = List.zipWith ca.div y1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1))) ++ List.zipWith ca.sub y2 (trans_fn y1) :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let y1p := p.1
      let y2p := p.2
      let tp := trans_fn y1p
      let x2p := List.zipWith ca.sub y2p tp

  let hx1_rec_2 : List.zipWith ca.div y1 s = x1 := zipWith_mul_div_cancel ca x1 s hx1s
  let hx1_rec := Eq.trans hx1_rec_1 hx1_rec_2
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hx1_rec hx2_rec) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def coupling_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t := trans_fn y1

  let s := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hy1 := hs.left
  let hy2 := hs.right

  let hx1_raw := length_zipWith ca.div y1 s hy1s
  let hx1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans hx1_raw hy1
  let hsplit := split_at_append dim x1 x2 hx1
  let hsimp : couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (x1 ++ x2) = List.zipWith ca.mul x1 (scale_fn x2) ++ List.zipWith ca.add x2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 (scale_fn x2))) :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let x1p := p.1
      let x2p := p.2
      let sp := scale_fn x2p
      let y1p := List.zipWith ca.mul x1p sp
      let tp := trans_fn y1p
      let y2p := List.zipWith ca.add x2p tp
      y1p ++ y2p) hsplit
  let hy1_rec : List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s = y1 := zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca y1 s hy1s
  let ht_rec : trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s) = t := congrArg trans_fn hy1_rec
  let ht_add : List.zipWith ca.add x2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s)) = List.zipWith ca.add x2 t := congrArg (fun z : List F => List.zipWith ca.add x2 z) ht_rec
  let hy2t : y2.length = t.length := Eq.trans hy2 (eq_symm (h_trans y1))
  let hy2_rec_2 : List.zipWith ca.add x2 t = y2 := zipWith_sub_add_cancel ca y2 t hy2t
  let hy2_rec := Eq.trans ht_add hy2_rec_2
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hy1_rec hy2_rec) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

structure ScaleAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  scale : F
  two : F
  one : F
  distrib_add : ∀ x y z : F, add (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (add x y) z
  distrib_sub : ∀ x y z : F, sub (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (sub x y) z
  mul_comm : ∀ x y : F, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z : F, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one : ∀ x : F, mul x one = x
  add_sub_add : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) (add a b) = mul two a
  add_sub_sub : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) (sub a b) = mul two b
  sub_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, sub (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two u
  add_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, add (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two v
  scale_property : mul (mul two scale) scale = one

def oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  u ++ v

def oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  x1 ++ x2

def scale_two_cancel (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (x : F) : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = x :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two x) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two x)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul x sa.two) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.mul_assoc x sa.two sa.scale)
  let h3 : sa.mul (sa.mul x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) := sa.mul_assoc x (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h4 : sa.mul x (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale) = sa.mul x sa.one := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul x z) sa.scale_property
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h4 (sa.mul_one x))))

def first_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two a) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_add a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa a))

def second_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two b) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_sub a b)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa b))

def first_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two u) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.sub_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa u))

def second_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  let h1 : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul z sa.scale) (sa.distrib_add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)
  let h2 : sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u)) sa.scale) sa.scale = sa.mul (sa.mul (sa.mul sa.two v) sa.scale) sa.scale := congrArg (fun z : F => sa.mul (sa.mul z sa.scale) sa.scale) (sa.add_add_sub_rev u v)
  Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (scale_two_cancel sa v))

def prove_inverse_pair (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) : sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a ∧ sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof sa a b) (second_component_proof sa a b)

def prove_inverse_pair_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) : sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u ∧ sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof_rev sa u v) (second_component_proof_rev sa u v)

def zipWith_inverse_list (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) : (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2
| [], [], h => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
| [], b :: bs, h => nomatch h
| a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  let ih := zipWith_inverse_list sa as bs ht
  let hp := prove_inverse_pair sa a b
  And.intro (congr_cons hp.left ih.left) (congr_cons hp.right ih.right)

def zipWith_inverse_list_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) : (L1 L2 : List F) → L1.length = L2.length → List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2
| [], [], h => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
| [], b :: bs, h => nomatch h
| a :: as, [], h => nomatch h
| a :: as, b :: bs, h =>
  let ht := succ_inj h
  let ih := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa as bs ht
  let hp := prove_inverse_pair_rev sa a b
  And.intro (congr_cons hp.left ih.left) (congr_cons hp.right ih.right)

def length_oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : (oftbForward sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx12 : x1.length = x2.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm hx2)
  let hu_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 hx12
  let hv_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 hx12
  let hu : u.length = dim := Eq.trans hu_raw hx1
  let hv : v.length = dim := Eq.trans hv_raw hx1

def length_oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : (oftbInverse sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hu := hs.left
  let hv := hs.right
  let huv : u.length = v.length := Eq.trans hu (eq_symm hv)
  let hx1_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v huv
  let hx2_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v huv
  let hx1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans hx1_raw hu
  let hx2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans hx2_raw hu

def oftb_invertible (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : oftbInverse sa dim (oftbForward sa dim L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let hs := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let hx1 := hs.left
  let hx2 := hs.right
  let hx12 : x1.length = x2.length := Eq.trans hx1 (eq_symm hx2)
  let hu_raw := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 hx12
  let hu : u.length = dim := Eq.trans hu_raw hx1
  let hsplit := split_at_append dim u v hu
  let hsimp : oftbInverse sa dim (u ++ v) = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v ++ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let up := p.1
      let vp := p.2
      let x1p := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) up vp
      let x2p := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) up vp
      x1p ++ x2p) hsplit
  let hp := zipWith_inverse_list sa x1 x2 hx12
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hp.left hp.right) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def oftb_invertible_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) : oftbForward sa dim (oftbInverse sa dim L) = L :=
  let u := (split_at dim L).1
  let v := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v

  let hsplit := split_at_append dim x1 x2 hx1
  let hsimp : oftbForward sa dim (x1 ++ x2) = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 ++ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 :=
    congrArg (fun p : List F × List F =>
      let x1p := p.1
      let x2p := p.2
      let up := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1p x2p
      let vp := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1p x2p
      up ++ vp) hsplit
  let hp := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa u v huv
  Eq.trans hsimp (Eq.trans (congr_append hp.left hp.right) (split_at_reconstruct dim L))

def rsfStepForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  oftbForward sa dim (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L)

def rsfStepInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (oftbInverse sa dim L)

def rsfStep_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let M := couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L
  let hM := length_couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L h h_scale h_trans
  let hmix := oftb_invertible sa dim M hM

def rsfStep_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=

def WellFormedSpec (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) : Prop :=
  (∀ x2 : List F, (spec.scale_fn x2).length = dim) ∧ (∀ y1 : List F, (spec.trans_fn y1).length = dim)

def AllWellFormed (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) : Prop :=
  ∀ spec, spec ∈ specs → WellFormedSpec F dim spec

def allWellFormed_cons_head {F : Type} {dim : Nat} {spec : LayerSpec F} {rest : List (LayerSpec F)} (h : AllWellFormed F dim (spec :: rest)) : WellFormedSpec F dim spec :=

def length_rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L).length = dim + dim
| [], L, h, hwf => h
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>

def rsfN_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs (rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L) = L
| [], L, h, hwf => Eq.refl L
| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>
  let M := rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L
  let hhead := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
  let hM := length_rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec L h hhead
  let ih := rsfN_forward_inverse ca sa dim rest M hM htail
  let hstep := rsfStep_forward_inverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L h hhead.left hhead.right

def rsfN_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) : (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) → (L : List F) → L.length = dim + dim → AllWellFormed F dim specs → rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L) = L

| spec :: rest, L, h, hwf =>

  let htail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf

  let hstep := rsfStep_inverse_forward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn N hN hhead.left hhead.right
  let ih := rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim rest L h htail
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q : List F => rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest q) hstep) ih

def RSFPrecondition (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : Prop :=
  dim > 0 ∧ L.length = dim + dim ∧ AllWellFormed F dim specs

def rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=

def rsfInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=

def length_rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : (rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h).length = dim + dim :=

def rsf_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :

A korábbi verzióban minden abszurd eset (pl. amikor egy lista hossza egyszerre 0 és succ valami) egy kétlépéses konstrukciót használt: előbb `zero_not_succ`/`succ_not_zero` segédlemma bizonyította a `False`-t, majd `False.elim` alkalmazta ezt a célra. A `nomatch` a Lean 4 beépített "no confusion" mechanizmusát hívja meg, amely a kernel szintjén ismeri fel, hogy két különböző konstruktor (`0` és `Nat.succ n`) sosem lehet egyenlő.[1][2]

## Miért érvényes és nem trükk

Ez nem "elrejti" a bizonyítást, hanem pontosan azt teszi, amit a `succ_not_zero`/`zero_not_succ` lemmák is tettek belsőleg – csak most a Lean elaborátor automatikusan generálja ezt az érvelést a `match`/`nomatch` szintaxis mögött, ahelyett hogy explicit segédfüggvényt hívnál. A `nomatch h` valójában azt jelenti: "ez a hipotézis egy olyan típus eleme, amelynek nincs konstruktora ebben az esetben, tehát a cél automatikusan lezárható" — ez pontosan megegyezik a `False.elim (nomatch h)` szemantikájával, csak tömörebb formában. ## Gyakorlati előny

A tömörebb forma két szempontból jobb: kevesebb a felesleges kódduplikáció (a `zero_not_succ`/`succ_not_zero` lemmákat definiáltad, de már nem kell mindenhol explicit módon meghívni őket), és a `nomatch Eq.trans h (nat_succ_add k m)` mintázat közvetlenül az adott kontextusban származtatott egyenlőségre reagál, nem egy általános segédlemmára — ez jobban tükrözi, hogy a konkrét ellentmondás honnan ered.
