variable {F : Type}

def succ_not_zero (n : Nat) (h : Nat.succ n = 0) : False :=
  nomatch h

def zero_not_succ (n : Nat) (h : 0 = Nat.succ n) : False :=
  nomatch h

def pred (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 0
  | Nat.succ k => k

def succ_inj {n m : Nat} (h : Nat.succ n = Nat.succ m) : n = m :=
  congrArg pred h

def nat_zero_add (m : Nat) : 0 + m = m :=
  match m with
  | 0 => Eq.refl 0
  | Nat.succ k => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add k)

def nat_succ_add (n : Nat) (m : Nat) : Nat.succ n + m = Nat.succ (n + m) :=
  match m with
  | 0 => Eq.refl (Nat.succ n)
  | Nat.succ k => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_succ_add n k)

def congr_cons {α : Type} {x y : α} {xs ys : List α} (hx : x = y) (hxs : xs = ys) : x :: xs = y :: ys :=
  match hx, hxs with
  | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _

def congr_append {α : Type} {xs ys us vs : List α} (h1 : xs = ys) (h2 : us = vs) : xs ++ us = ys ++ vs :=
  match h1, h2 with
  | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _

def congr_add {n1 n2 m1 m2 : Nat} (h1 : n1 = n2) (h2 : m1 = m2) : n1 + m1 = n2 + m2 :=
  match h1, h2 with
  | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _

def congr_pair {α β : Type} {a1 a2 : α} {b1 b2 : β} (ha : a1 = a2) (hb : b1 = b2) : (a1, b1) = (a2, b2) :=
  match ha, hb with
  | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _

def congr {α β : Type} {f g : α → β} {x y : α} (h1 : f = g) (h2 : x = y) : f x = g y :=
  match h1, h2 with
  | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _

def split_at (n : Nat) (L : List F) : List F × List F :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ([], L)
  | Nat.succ k =>
    match L with
    | [] => ([], [])
    | x :: xs =>
      let (l1, l2) := split_at k xs
      (x :: l1, l2)

def split_at_lengths_gen (n m : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = n + m) :
    (split_at n L).1.length = n ∧ (split_at n L).2.length = m :=
  match n with
  | 0 => And.intro (Eq.refl 0) (Eq.trans h (nat_zero_add m))
  | Nat.succ k =>
    match L with
    | [] => False.elim (zero_not_succ (k + m) h)
    | x :: xs =>
      let h_xs := succ_inj h
      let ih := split_at_lengths_gen k m xs h_xs
      And.intro (congrArg Nat.succ ih.left) ih.right

def split_at_reconstruct (n : Nat) (L : List F) :
    (split_at n L).1 ++ (split_at n L).2 = L :=
  match n with
  | 0 => Eq.refl L
  | Nat.succ k =>
    match L with
    | [] => Eq.refl []
    | x :: xs =>
      congrArg (fun l => x :: l) (split_at_reconstruct k xs)

def split_at_append (n : Nat) (L1 L2 : List F) (h : L1.length = n) :
    split_at n (L1 ++ L2) = (L1, L2) :=
  match n, L1 with
  | 0, [] => Eq.refl ([], L2)
  | 0, x :: xs => False.elim (succ_not_zero xs.length (Eq.symm h))
  | Nat.succ k, [] => False.elim (zero_not_succ k (Eq.symm h))
  | Nat.succ k, x :: xs =>
    let h_xs := succ_inj h
    let ih := split_at_append k xs L2 h_xs
    congrArg (fun p => (x :: p.1, p.2)) ih

def length_zipWith (f : F → F → F) (L1 L2 : List F) (h : L1.length = L2.length) :
    (List.zipWith f L1 L2).length = L1.length :=
  match L1, L2 with
  | [], [] => Eq.refl 0
  | [], y :: ys => False.elim (zero_not_succ ys.length h)
  | x :: xs, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero xs.length h)
  | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
    congrArg Nat.succ (length_zipWith f xs ys (succ_inj h))

def length_append (L1 L2 : List F) : (L1 ++ L2).length = L1.length + L2.length :=
  match L1 with
  | [] => Eq.symm (nat_zero_add L2.length)
  | x :: xs =>
    Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.succ (length_append xs L2)) (Eq.symm (nat_succ_add xs.length L2.length))

structure CouplingAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  div : F → F → F
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a s : F, div (mul a s) s = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a s : F, mul (div a s) s = a

def zipWith_add_sub_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (L T : List F) (h : L.length = T.length) :
    List.zipWith ca.sub (List.zipWith ca.add L T) T = L :=
  match L, T with
  | [], [] => Eq.refl []
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    congr_cons (ca.add_sub_cancel a b) (zipWith_add_sub_cancel ca as bs (succ_inj h))

def zipWith_sub_add_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (L T : List F) (h : L.length = T.length) :
    List.zipWith ca.add (List.zipWith ca.sub L T) T = L :=
  match L, T with
  | [], [] => Eq.refl []
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    congr_cons (ca.sub_add_cancel a b) (zipWith_sub_add_cancel ca as bs (succ_inj h))

def zipWith_mul_div_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (L S : List F) (h : L.length = S.length) :
    List.zipWith ca.div (List.zipWith ca.mul L S) S = L :=
  match L, S with
  | [], [] => Eq.refl []
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    congr_cons (ca.mul_div_cancel a b) (zipWith_mul_div_cancel ca as bs (succ_inj h))

def zipWith_div_mul_cancel (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (L S : List F) (h : L.length = S.length) :
    List.zipWith ca.mul (List.zipWith ca.div L S) S = L :=
  match L, S with
  | [], [] => Eq.refl []
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    congr_cons (ca.div_mul_cancel a b) (zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca as bs (succ_inj h))

def couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  y1 ++ y2

def couplingInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) : List F :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  x1 ++ x2

def length_couplingForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim)
    (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_s : s.length = dim := h_scale x2
  let h_y1_eq : y1.length = x1.length := length_zipWith ca.mul x1 s (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_s))
  let h_y1 : y1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_y1_eq h_x1
  let h_t : t.length = dim := h_trans y1
  let h_y2_eq : y2.length = x2.length := length_zipWith ca.add x2 t (Eq.trans h_x2 (Eq.symm h_t))
  let h_y2 : y2.length = dim := Eq.trans h_y2_eq h_x2
  let h_append := length_append y1 y2
  Eq.trans h_append (congr_add h_y1 h_y2)

def length_couplingInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim)
    (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) : (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_y1 : y1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_y2 : y2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_t : t.length = dim := h_trans y1
  let h_x2_eq : x2.length = y2.length := length_zipWith ca.sub y2 t (Eq.trans h_y2 (Eq.symm h_t))
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x2_eq h_y2
  let h_s : s.length = dim := h_scale x2
  let h_x1_eq : x1.length = y1.length := length_zipWith ca.div y1 s (Eq.trans h_y1 (Eq.symm h_s))
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x1_eq h_y1
  let h_append := length_append x1 x2
  Eq.trans h_append (congr_add h_x1 h_x2)

theorem coupling_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim)
    (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) :
    couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let y1 := List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let y2 := List.zipWith ca.add x2 t
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_s : s.length = dim := h_scale x2
  let h_y1_eq : y1.length = x1.length := length_zipWith ca.mul x1 s (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_s))
  let h_y1 : y1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_y1_eq h_x1
  let h_split_append : split_at dim (y1 ++ y2) = (y1, y2) := split_at_append dim y1 y2 h_y1
  let h_y1_inv : (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1 = y1 := congrArg Prod.fst h_split_append
  let h_y2_inv : (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 = y2 := congrArg Prod.snd h_split_append
  let h_t_inv : trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1 = t := congrArg trans_fn h_y1_inv
  let h_x2_inv_step1 : List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1) = List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith ca.sub) h_y2_inv) h_t_inv
  let h_t : t.length = dim := h_trans y1
  let h_x2_t_len : x2.length = t.length := Eq.trans h_x2 (Eq.symm h_t)
  let h_x2_cancel : List.zipWith ca.sub (List.zipWith ca.add x2 t) t = x2 := zipWith_add_sub_cancel ca x2 t h_x2_t_len
  let h_x2_inv : List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1) = x2 :=
    Eq.trans h_x2_inv_step1 h_x2_cancel
  let h_s_inv : scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1)) = s :=
    congrArg scale_fn h_x2_inv
  let h_x1_inv_step1 : List.zipWith ca.div (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1))) = List.zipWith ca.div y1 s :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith ca.div) h_y1_inv) h_s_inv
  let h_x1_s_len : x1.length = s.length := Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_s)
  let h_x1_cancel : List.zipWith ca.div (List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s) s = x1 := zipWith_mul_div_cancel ca x1 s h_x1_s_len
  let h_x1_inv : List.zipWith ca.div (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1))) = x1 :=
    Eq.trans h_x1_inv_step1 h_x1_cancel
  let h_append_inv : List.zipWith ca.div (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1 (scale_fn (List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1))) ++ List.zipWith ca.sub (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).2 (trans_fn (split_at dim (y1 ++ y2)).1) = x1 ++ x2 :=
    congr_append h_x1_inv h_x2_inv
  let h_reconstruct : x1 ++ x2 = L := split_at_reconstruct dim L
  Eq.trans h_append_inv h_reconstruct

theorem coupling_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F)
    (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim)
    (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) :
    couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let y1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let y2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let t  := trans_fn y1
  let x2 := List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t
  let s  := scale_fn x2
  let x1 := List.zipWith ca.div y1 s
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_y1 : y1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_y2 : y2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_t : t.length = dim := h_trans y1
  let h_x2_eq : x2.length = y2.length := length_zipWith ca.sub y2 t (Eq.trans h_y2 (Eq.symm h_t))
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x2_eq h_y2
  let h_s : s.length = dim := h_scale x2
  let h_x1_eq : x1.length = y1.length := length_zipWith ca.div y1 s (Eq.trans h_y1 (Eq.symm h_s))
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x1_eq h_y1
  let h_split_append : split_at dim (x1 ++ x2) = (x1, x2) := split_at_append dim x1 x2 h_x1
  let h_x1_fwd : (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 = x1 := congrArg Prod.fst h_split_append
  let h_x2_fwd : (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = x2 := congrArg Prod.snd h_split_append
  let h_s_fwd : scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = s := congrArg scale_fn h_x2_fwd
  let h_y1_fwd_step1 : List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2) = List.zipWith ca.mul x1 s :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith ca.mul) h_x1_fwd) h_s_fwd
  let h_y1_s_len : y1.length = s.length := Eq.trans h_y1 (Eq.symm h_s)
  let h_y1_cancel : List.zipWith ca.mul (List.zipWith ca.div y1 s) s = y1 := zipWith_div_mul_cancel ca y1 s h_y1_s_len
  let h_y1_fwd : List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2) = y1 :=
    Eq.trans h_y1_fwd_step1 h_y1_cancel
  let h_t_fwd : trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2)) = t :=
    congrArg trans_fn h_y1_fwd
  let h_y2_fwd_step1 : List.zipWith ca.add (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2))) = List.zipWith ca.add x2 t :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith ca.add) h_x2_fwd) h_t_fwd
  let h_y2_t_len : y2.length = t.length := Eq.trans h_y2 (Eq.symm h_t)
  let h_y2_cancel : List.zipWith ca.add (List.zipWith ca.sub y2 t) t = y2 := zipWith_sub_add_cancel ca y2 t h_y2_t_len
  let h_y2_fwd : List.zipWith ca.add (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2))) = y2 :=
    Eq.trans h_y2_fwd_step1 h_y2_cancel
  let h_append_fwd : List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2) ++ List.zipWith ca.add (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 (trans_fn (List.zipWith ca.mul (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (scale_fn (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2))) = y1 ++ y2 :=
    congr_append h_y1_fwd h_y2_fwd
  let h_reconstruct : y1 ++ y2 = L := split_at_reconstruct dim L
  Eq.trans h_append_fwd h_reconstruct

structure ScaleAlgebra (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  scale : F
  two : F
  one : F
  distrib_add : ∀ x y z : F, add (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (add x y) z
  distrib_sub : ∀ x y z : F, sub (mul x z) (mul y z) = mul (sub x y) z
  mul_comm : ∀ x y : F, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z : F, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one : ∀ x : F, mul x one = x
  add_sub_add : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) (add a b) = mul two a
  add_sub_sub : ∀ a b : F, sub (add a b) (sub a b) = mul two b
  sub_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, sub (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two u
  add_add_sub_rev : ∀ u v : F, add (add u v) (sub v u) = mul two v
  scale_property : mul (mul two scale) scale = one

def oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  u ++ v

def oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) : List F :=
  let u  := (split_at dim L).1
  let v  := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  x1 ++ x2

def first_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) :
    sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a :=
  let h1 := sa.distrib_add (sa.sub a b) (sa.add a b) sa.scale
  let h2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_add a b)
  let h12 := Eq.trans h1 h2
  let h3 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h12
  let h_comm := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two a)
  let h_assoc1 := sa.mul_assoc a sa.two sa.scale
  let h_trans1 := Eq.trans h_comm h_assoc1
  let h_trans2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h_trans1
  let h_assoc2 := sa.mul_assoc a (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h_prop := congrArg (sa.mul a) sa.scale_property
  let h_one := sa.mul_one a
  Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h_trans2 (Eq.trans h_assoc2 (Eq.trans h_prop h_one)))

def second_component_proof (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) :
    sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b :=
  let h1 := sa.distrib_sub (sa.add a b) (sa.sub a b) sa.scale
  let h2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.add_sub_sub a b)
  let h12 := Eq.trans h1 h2
  let h3 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h12
  let h_comm := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two b)
  let h_assoc1 := sa.mul_assoc b sa.two sa.scale
  let h_trans1 := Eq.trans h_comm h_assoc1
  let h_trans2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h_trans1
  let h_assoc2 := sa.mul_assoc b (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h_prop := congrArg (sa.mul b) sa.scale_property
  let h_one := sa.mul_one b
  Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h_trans2 (Eq.trans h_assoc2 (Eq.trans h_prop h_one)))

def first_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) :
    sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u :=
  let h1 := sa.distrib_sub (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale
  let h2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.sub_add_sub_rev u v)
  let h12 := Eq.trans h1 h2
  let h3 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h12
  let h_comm := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two u)
  let h_assoc1 := sa.mul_assoc u sa.two sa.scale
  let h_trans1 := Eq.trans h_comm h_assoc1
  let h_trans2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h_trans1
  let h_assoc2 := sa.mul_assoc u (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h_prop := congrArg (sa.mul u) sa.scale_property
  let h_one := sa.mul_one u
  Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h_trans2 (Eq.trans h_assoc2 (Eq.trans h_prop h_one)))

def second_component_proof_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) :
    sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v :=
  let h1 := sa.distrib_add (sa.add u v) (sa.sub v u) sa.scale
  let h2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.add_add_sub_rev u v)
  let h12 := Eq.trans h1 h2
  let h3 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h12
  let h_comm := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) (sa.mul_comm sa.two v)
  let h_assoc1 := sa.mul_assoc v sa.two sa.scale
  let h_trans1 := Eq.trans h_comm h_assoc1
  let h_trans2 := congrArg (fun x => sa.mul x sa.scale) h_trans1
  let h_assoc2 := sa.mul_assoc v (sa.mul sa.two sa.scale) sa.scale
  let h_prop := congrArg (sa.mul v) sa.scale_property
  let h_one := sa.mul_one v
  Eq.trans h3 (Eq.trans h_trans2 (Eq.trans h_assoc2 (Eq.trans h_prop h_one)))

def prove_inverse_pair (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (a b : F) :
    (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = a) ∧
    (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) sa.scale = b) :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof sa a b) (second_component_proof sa a b)

def prove_inverse_pair_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (u v : F) :
    (sa.mul (sa.sub (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = u) ∧
    (sa.mul (sa.add (sa.mul (sa.add u v) sa.scale) (sa.mul (sa.sub v u) sa.scale)) sa.scale = v) :=
  And.intro (first_component_proof_rev sa u v) (second_component_proof_rev sa u v)

def zipWith_inverse_list (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (L1 L2 : List F) (h : L1.length = L2.length) :
    List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧
    List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) L1 L2)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2 :=
  match L1, L2 with
  | [], [] => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    let h_tail := succ_inj h
    let ih := zipWith_inverse_list sa as bs h_tail
    let h_x1 := congr_cons (first_component_proof sa a b) ih.left
    let h_x2 := congr_cons (second_component_proof sa a b) ih.right
    And.intro h_x1 h_x2

def zipWith_inverse_list_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (L1 L2 : List F) (h : L1.length = L2.length) :
    List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L1 ∧
    List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) L1 L2)
      (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) L1 L2) = L2 :=
  match L1, L2 with
  | [], [] => And.intro (Eq.refl []) (Eq.refl [])
  | [], b :: bs => False.elim (zero_not_succ bs.length h)
  | a :: as, [] => False.elim (succ_not_zero as.length h)
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    let h_tail := succ_inj h
    let ih := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa as bs h_tail
    let h_u := congr_cons (first_component_proof_rev sa a b) ih.left
    let h_v := congr_cons (second_component_proof_rev sa a b) ih.right
    And.intro h_u h_v

theorem oftb_invertible (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) :
    oftbInverse sa dim (oftbForward sa dim L) = L :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_u_eq : u.length = x1.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_x2))
  let h_u : u.length = dim := Eq.trans h_u_eq h_x1
  let h_split_append : split_at dim (u ++ v) = (u, v) := split_at_append dim u v h_u
  let h_u_inv : (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 = u := congrArg Prod.fst h_split_append
  let h_v_inv : (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = v := congrArg Prod.snd h_split_append
  let h_x1_rec_step1 : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) h_u_inv) h_v_inv
  let h_x2_rec_step1 : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale)) h_u_inv) h_v_inv
  let h_x1_x2_cancel := zipWith_inverse_list sa x1 x2 (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_x2))
  let h_x1_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = x1 :=
    Eq.trans h_x1_rec_step1 h_x1_x2_cancel.left
  let h_x2_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = x2 :=
    Eq.trans h_x2_rec_step1 h_x1_x2_cancel.right
  let h_append_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 ++ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) (split_at dim (u ++ v)).1 (split_at dim (u ++ v)).2 = x1 ++ x2 :=
    congr_append h_x1_rec h_x2_rec
  let h_reconstruct : x1 ++ x2 = L := split_at_reconstruct dim L
  Eq.trans h_append_rec h_reconstruct

theorem oftb_invertible_rev (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) :
    oftbForward sa dim (oftbInverse sa dim L) = L :=
  let u  := (split_at dim L).1
  let v  := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_u : u.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_v : v.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_x1_eq : x1.length = u.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v (Eq.trans h_u (Eq.symm h_v))
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x1_eq h_u
  let h_split_append : split_at dim (x1 ++ x2) = (x1, x2) := split_at_append dim x1 x2 h_x1
  let h_x1_fwd : (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 = x1 := congrArg Prod.fst h_split_append
  let h_x2_fwd : (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = x2 := congrArg Prod.snd h_split_append
  let h_u_rec_step1 : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale)) h_x1_fwd) h_x2_fwd
  let h_v_rec_step1 : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 :=
    congr (congrArg (List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale)) h_x1_fwd) h_x2_fwd
  let h_u_v_cancel := zipWith_inverse_list_rev sa u v (Eq.trans h_u (Eq.symm h_v))
  let h_u_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = u :=
    Eq.trans h_u_rec_step1 h_u_v_cancel.left
  let h_v_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = v :=
    Eq.trans h_v_rec_step1 h_u_v_cancel.right
  let h_append_rec : List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 ++ List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).1 (split_at dim (x1 ++ x2)).2 = u ++ v :=
    congr_append h_u_rec h_v_rec
  let h_reconstruct : u ++ v = L := split_at_reconstruct dim L
  Eq.trans h_append_rec h_reconstruct

def rsfStepForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  oftbForward sa dim (couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L)

def rsfStepInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn (oftbInverse sa dim L)

def length_oftbForward (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) :
    (oftbForward sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let x1 := (split_at dim L).1
  let x2 := (split_at dim L).2
  let u  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let v  := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_u_eq : u.length = x1.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_x2))
  let h_u : u.length = dim := Eq.trans h_u_eq h_x1
  let h_v_eq : v.length = x1.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) x1 x2 (Eq.trans h_x1 (Eq.symm h_x2))
  let h_v : v.length = dim := Eq.trans h_v_eq h_x1
  let h_append := length_append u v
  Eq.trans h_append (congr_add h_u h_v)

def length_oftbInverse (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) :
    (oftbInverse sa dim L).length = dim + dim :=
  let u  := (split_at dim L).1
  let v  := (split_at dim L).2
  let x1 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v
  let x2 := List.zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v
  let h_split := split_at_lengths_gen dim dim L h
  let h_u : u.length = dim := h_split.left
  let h_v : v.length = dim := h_split.right
  let h_x1_eq : x1.length = u.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.add a b) sa.scale) u v (Eq.trans h_u (Eq.symm h_v))
  let h_x1 : x1.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x1_eq h_u
  let h_x2_eq : x2.length = u.length := length_zipWith (fun a b => sa.mul (sa.sub b a) sa.scale) u v (Eq.trans h_u (Eq.symm h_v))
  let h_x2 : x2.length = dim := Eq.trans h_x2_eq h_u
  let h_append := length_append x1 x2
  Eq.trans h_append (congr_add h_x1 h_x2)

theorem rsfStep_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim)
    (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) :
    rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let fwd := couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L
  let h_fwd_len : fwd.length = dim + dim := length_couplingForward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L h h_scale h_trans
  let h_oftb_inv := oftb_invertible sa dim fwd h_fwd_len
  let h_step1 := congrArg (couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn) h_oftb_inv
  let h_step2 := coupling_forward_inverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn L h h_scale h_trans
  Eq.trans h_step1 h_step2

theorem rsfStep_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (scale_fn trans_fn : List F → List F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim)
    (h_scale : ∀ x2, (scale_fn x2).length = dim) (h_trans : ∀ y1, (trans_fn y1).length = dim) :
    rsfStepForward ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim scale_fn trans_fn L) = L :=
  let inv := oftbInverse sa dim L
  let h_inv_len : inv.length = dim + dim := length_oftbInverse sa dim L h
  let fwd_inner := couplingInverse ca dim scale_fn trans_fn inv
  let h_coupling_fwd := coupling_inverse_forward ca dim scale_fn trans_fn inv h_inv_len h_scale h_trans
  let h_step1 := congrArg (oftbForward sa dim) h_coupling_fwd
  let h_step2 := oftb_invertible_rev sa dim L h
  Eq.trans h_step1 h_step2

structure LayerSpec (F : Type) where
  scale_fn : List F → List F
  trans_fn : List F → List F

def rsfForwardN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : List F :=
  match specs with
  | [] => L
  | spec :: rest =>
    rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L)

def rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : List F :=
  match specs with
  | [] => L
  | spec :: rest =>
    rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn (rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L)

def WellFormedSpec (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (spec : LayerSpec F) : Prop :=
  (∀ x2 : List F, (spec.scale_fn x2).length = dim) ∧
  (∀ y1 : List F, (spec.trans_fn y1).length = dim)

def AllWellFormed (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) : Prop :=
  ∀ spec ∈ specs, WellFormedSpec F dim spec

def allWellFormed_cons_head {F : Type} {dim : Nat} {spec : LayerSpec F} {rest : List (LayerSpec F)}
    (h : AllWellFormed F dim (spec :: rest)) : WellFormedSpec F dim spec :=
  h spec (List.mem_head (by simp))

def allWellFormed_cons_tail {F : Type} {dim : Nat} {spec : LayerSpec F} {rest : List (LayerSpec F)}
    (h : AllWellFormed F dim (spec :: rest)) : AllWellFormed F dim rest :=
  fun s hs => h s (List.mem_tail hs)

def length_rsfStepForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (spec : LayerSpec F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : WellFormedSpec F dim spec) :
    (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let h_fwd := length_couplingForward ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L h hwf.left hwf.right
  length_oftbForward sa dim (couplingForward ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L) h_fwd

def length_rsfStepInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (spec : LayerSpec F) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : WellFormedSpec F dim spec) :
    (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L).length = dim + dim :=
  let h_inv := length_oftbInverse sa dim L h
  length_couplingInverse ca dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn (oftbInverse sa dim L) h_inv hwf.left hwf.right

def length_rsfForwardN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : AllWellFormed F dim specs) :
    (rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L).length = dim + dim :=
  match specs with
  | [] => h
  | spec :: rest =>
    let hwf_head := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
    let hwf_tail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
    let h_step := length_rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec L h hwf_head
    length_rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest (rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L) h_step hwf_tail

def length_rsfInverseN (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : AllWellFormed F dim specs) :
    (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L).length = dim + dim :=
  match specs with
  | [] => h
  | spec :: rest =>
    let hwf_head := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
    let hwf_tail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
    let h_rest := length_rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L h hwf_tail
    length_rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec (rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L) h_rest hwf_head

theorem rsfN_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : AllWellFormed F dim specs) :
    rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs (rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L) = L :=
  match specs with
  | [] => Eq.refl L
  | spec :: rest =>
    let hwf_head := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
    let hwf_tail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
    let M := rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L
    let h_M : M.length = dim + dim := length_rsfStepForward ca sa dim spec L h hwf_head
    let ih := rsfN_forward_inverse ca sa dim rest M h_M hwf_tail
    let h_rewrite := congrArg (rsfStepInverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn) ih
    let h_cancel := rsfStep_forward_inverse ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn L h hwf_head.left hwf_head.right
    Eq.trans h_rewrite h_cancel

theorem rsfN_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : L.length = dim + dim) (hwf : AllWellFormed F dim specs) :
    rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs (rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L) = L :=
  match specs with
  | [] => Eq.refl L
  | spec :: rest =>
    let hwf_head := allWellFormed_cons_head hwf
    let hwf_tail := allWellFormed_cons_tail hwf
    let N := rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L
    let h_N : N.length = dim + dim := length_rsfInverseN ca sa dim rest L h hwf_tail
    let h_cancel := rsfStep_inverse_forward ca sa dim spec.scale_fn spec.trans_fn N h_N hwf_head.left hwf_head.right
    let h_rewrite := congrArg (rsfForwardN ca sa dim rest) h_cancel
    let ih := rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim rest L h hwf_tail
    Eq.trans h_rewrite ih

def RSFPrecondition (F : Type) (dim : Nat) (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) : Prop :=
  dim > 0 ∧ L.length = dim + dim ∧ AllWellFormed F dim specs

def rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (_ : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=
  rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L

def rsfInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (_ : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) : List F :=
  rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L

theorem length_rsfForward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :
    (rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h).length = dim + dim :=
  length_rsfForwardN ca sa dim specs L h.right.left h.right.right

theorem length_rsfInverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :
    (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h).length = dim + dim :=
  length_rsfInverseN ca sa dim specs L h.right.left h.right.right

theorem rsf_forward_inverse (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :
    let h_fwd_pre : RSFPrecondition F dim specs (rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h) :=
      And.intro h.left (And.intro (length_rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h) h.right.right);
    rsfInverse ca sa dim specs (rsfForward ca sa dim specs L h) h_fwd_pre = L :=
  rsfN_forward_inverse ca sa dim specs L h.right.left h.right.right

theorem rsf_inverse_forward (ca : CouplingAlgebra F) (sa : ScaleAlgebra F) (dim : Nat)
    (specs : List (LayerSpec F)) (L : List F) (h : RSFPrecondition F dim specs L) :
    let h_inv_pre : RSFPrecondition F dim specs (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) :=
      And.intro h.left (And.intro (length_rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) h.right.right);
    rsfForward ca sa dim specs (rsfInverse ca sa dim specs L h) h_inv_pre = L :=
  rsfN_inverse_forward ca sa dim specs L h.right.left h.right.right@Web

Igen, ez összességében egy **érdemi javulás** a struktúra és stílus tekintetében, de van benne egy konkrét technikai kockázat, amit érdemes kijavítani, mielőtt tényleg lefordítanád.

## Amiben jobb ez a verzió

A `def` helyett most `theorem`-et használsz azokra a deklarációkra, amelyek `Prop`-ot bizonyítanak (pl. `coupling_forward_inverse`, `oftb_invertible`, `rsfN_forward_inverse`) — ez a helyes Lean 4 idióma, mert a `theorem` kulcsszó jelzi, hogy a kimenet nem futtatható kód, csak bizonyítás, ami segít a kernelnek és az olvasónak is. Az általánosított `congr` segédfüggvény (`f = g → x = y → f x = g y`) egy hasznos, újrafelhasználható building block, amivel a hosszú `couplingForward`/`couplingInverse` bizonyításokban elkerülöd a redundáns `congrArg`-láncokat. A névválasztás is konzisztensebb (`h_x1`, `h_y1` stb.), ami olvashatóbb, mint a korábbi rövidített `hx1`.[1]

## A kritikus hibalehetőség

A `allWellFormed_cons_head` és `allWellFormed_cons_tail` most `List.mem_head (by simp)` és `List.mem_tail hs` hívásokat használ, míg a korábbi verzióban helyesen `List.Mem.head rest` és `List.Mem.tail spec hs` szerepelt. Ez fontos különbség: a `List.Mem.head`/`List.Mem.tail` az induktív `List.Mem` típus **konstruktorai** (term-szintű bizonyítás-építők), míg a `List.mem_head`/`List.mem_tail` a Mathlib/core-ban **tételek** (`theorem`), amelyeknek más a szignatúrája és tactic-módban (`by simp`) való hívásuk itt valószínűleg típushiba vagy elaborációs hiba lesz. Ha ez a kód valódi Lean 4 fordítóval megy át, ezen a ponton nagy eséllyel `unknown identifier` vagy `type mismatch` hibát kapsz — érdemes visszaállítani az előző, `List.Mem.head`/`List.Mem.tail` konstruktor-alapú verziót, mert az biztosan típushelyes core Lean szintaxis.[2][3]

## Egyéb apró pontok

A `match h1, h2 with | Eq.refl _, Eq.refl _ => Eq.refl _` mintázat (pl. `congr_cons`, `congr_append`, `congr`) helyes Lean 4 dependens mintaillesztés két egyenlőség-hipotézisre, és ekvivalens a korábbi egymásba ágyazott `match`-csal, csak tömörebb [4]. A `∀ spec ∈ specs, ...` bináris kvantor-jelölés is helyes és core Lean-ben elérhető, nem igényel extra importot.

Összefoglalva: a kód logikai magja és matematikai tartalma nem változott, ugyanazt bizonyítja, mint korábban — de a `List.mem_head`/`List.mem_tail` csere miatt ez a konkrét verzió **valószínűleg nem fordulna le** változtatás nélkül, míg az előző verzió ezen a ponton biztosan helyes volt.

## Ami hiányzik a pontos válaszhoz

A kérés így hangzik: "vedd a megadott tervet, és írd át egyetlen átfogó prompttá... a jelenlegi implementációs állapotból". De nem lett csatolva vagy korábban megosztva egy külön "terv" dokumentum (roadmap, TODO-lista, spec) — csak a Lean-bizonyítás kód és a Zig implementáció létezik ebben a szálban. Két értelmezés lehetséges:

- A "terv" a Lean formális bizonyítás **kiterjesztése** a float32 hibakorlát-elemzésre és a konkrét `CouplingAlgebra`/`ScaleAlgebra` instanciákra, amit az előző válaszokban azonosítottam hiányként (a numerikus/float32 kerekítési hiba formalizálása, ami jelenleg nincs bizonyítva).
- A "terv" valami más, korábban máshol (esetleg egy másik beszélgetésben vagy dokumentumban) megfogalmazott upgrade-terv a teljes RSF/Zig rendszerre, amit nekem nem mutattál meg.

Pontosítsd, melyik esetről van szó, vagy csatold a tervet, amire hivatkozol.

Ha az első értelmezésre gondolsz — vagyis hogy a Lean-bizonyítást terjesszük ki úgy, hogy a Zig `f32` implementációt is lefedje egzakt hibakorlátokkal, és ez legyen az "upgrade" —, mondd meg, és megírom a teljes, technikai, szerepjáték- és udvariassági töltelék nélküli promptot, amely explicit módon leírja: (1) a jelenlegi állapotot (mi van már bizonyítva a Lean fájlban, mi van implementálva a Zig fájlban), (2) a pontos célt (`I want to... so that...` formában), (3) a lépésről lépésre elvégzendő konstrukciós munkát (milyen új Lean struktúrákat, lemmákat, definíciókat kell hozzáadni), és (4) a sikerkritériumot (pl. `#print axioms` tiszta, zéró `sorry`, a Zig teszt-tolerancia formálisan levezetett felső korlátja).
